Auction Name: Ratite's Selection: Private Collection Auction
Currency: Credits

Lot No.: 001
Lot Name: Misprinted "Cosmicon Collective" Card Set
Lot Description:
Includes four one-of-a-kind cards: "Gastorice," "Ricecasto," "Castorfly," and "Caztorise."
Due to a printing plate misalignment, the card names and artwork are severely mismatched. Certified by professional appraisal institutions as a "one-of-a-kind cosmic item." Encapsulated in a protective anti-counterfeit case with minor surface scratches on the case.
Starting Bid: 10,000,000
Estimated Value: 20,000,000 – 40,000,000

Lot No.: 002
Lot Name: "The Amber Lord's Pardon"
Lot Description:
Certificate of authorization for the Grand Prize of the Interastral Peace Corporation's "New Millennium" Annual Gala, Amber Era 2000. Features a holographic signature by Louis Fleming. Grants one unconditional waiver for a major liability. Certificate No. 2000-001. Mint condition.
Starting Bid: 500,000,000
Estimated Value: 700,000,000 – 1,200,000,000

Lot No.: 003
Lot Name: Gopher Wood's Lingering Melody
Lot Description:
A music box left behind by Gopher Wood, the Penaconian "Dreammaster." This collection was provided by a mysterious consignor, who also designated the starting bid: "For those who know its worth, the secret contained within this music box far exceeds the asking price." Excellent condition.
Starting Bid: 900,000,000
Estimated Value: 1,200,000,000 – 1,800,000,000

Lot No.: 004
Lot Name: Thought-Sync Gel • First Edition
Lot Description:
The prototype behind "I Get You • Gum," the legendary misunderstanding-buster from the hit series This Cosmos Needs No Soap Opera. Chew a piece of Thought-Sync Gel, and you'll instantly tap into whatever was on the previous chewer's mind. This lot has already been chewed, allegedly by a member of the Genius Society. Authenticity cannot be guaranteed.
Starting Bid: 5,000,000
Estimated Value: 8,000,000 – 12,000,000
